in_marathi.name: Baidyanath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of Baidya (healer)
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baidyanath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baidyanath is a revered name in Hindu mythology, derived from the Sanskrit words 'Baidya' meaning healer and 'Nath' meaning master or lord. This name is traditionally given to a boy, signifying the belief that the child will grow up to be a healer or a wise guide. In Hindu mythology, Lord Shiva is known as Baidyanath, the lord of healing.
